title: helictotrichon planifolium
intro: Helictotrichon planifolium, commonly known as Blue Oat Grass, is a type of ornamental grass native to Europe. The plant has been traditionally used to promote relaxation and reduce stress, with health benefits including the ability to help alleviate anxiety and insomnia, as well as its potential to lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Blue Oat Grass include its sedative and anxiolytic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. Research suggests that the plant's bioactive constituents, including saponins and sesquiterpenes, may be responsible for its therapeutic actions.
